notes: bash -n parses clean. shellcheck not available in this environment (acceptable per plan's conditional wording). grep confirms no literal agent name in the new section's code (only pre-existing budget-cap table entries elsewhere in the file).

Behavioral verification (running the deployed copy) deferred to Phase 4 per the plan's dependency graph -- deploy-root-guard.sh blocks execution from the source store.
